_comment: Lane A validation config for validate.py. Copy per app into the project brain and edit. URLs point at the app running in its homologation/test profile (real TEST keys, mirrored test catalog, `stripe listen` forwarding webhooks). Each check is independent; status is pass|fail|pending.

checks.name: 3DS card → requires_action
checks._note: Completing the 3DS challenge itself is Lane B (browser); here we assert the intent enters requires_action.

checks.name: app reports purchase SUCCEEDED after webhook
checks._note: Trigger the real flow first (Lane B checkout OR `stripe trigger payment_intent.succeeded`), then this poll asserts the app persisted the end-state. Replace the pi id + token after creating the intent.

checks.name: subscription active after checkout.session.completed
checks._note: Drive the Checkout Session in the browser (Lane B) or `stripe trigger checkout.session.completed`, then assert the app activated it. Renewals/trials → use a Stripe Test Clock (see SKILL.md).
